biggest_gaps: Empty/broken sections: 'What temperature should you use?' and a trade-off bullet are blank, leaving unanswered questions and a visible formatting error that undermines trust and usefulness.

Voice is thin and mechanical compared to benchmarks — no context, no 'why it matters', no real-world framing (e.g. what to expect on first loads, sensitive skin, scent/feel differences beyond one line).

Trade-offs and caution are underdeveloped: benchmarks name who it suits/doesn't, note heavy soiling limits, and avoid overpromising; the new article lists trade-offs but doesn't explain them or set expectations about cleaning performance.
what_new_does_well: Clear, scannable step-by-step structure with FAQ block that maps well to search intent.
Honest, plain-language trade-off section and a sensible 'try one load' invitation rather than hard sell.
Sticks to supplied product facts (4 kg, two balls for larger loads, monthly sunlight recharge) without inventing claims.
